SwiftTerm 1.15.0
Upstream: https://github.com/migueldeicaza/SwiftTerm
Revision: dd2fb8ac5b861e7bf617c872895e338f38165648

Lithe compiles this fixed-version library with a typography patch:
- Font and line-spacing changes use native geometry updates without DECSTR.
- macOS can update font and line spacing together with one grid resize.
- Typography changes invalidate renderer caches, including cascade-only changes.
- macOS defers complete typography changes during synchronized output. Metal
  pauses drawing; Core Graphics preserves onscreen backing contents through the
  native redraw policy. The original policy is restored when the frame commits.
- The package manifest contains only the library and its runtime resources.

The accompanying LICENSE contains the full upstream copyright and MIT terms.
Source provenance and the reversible patch are in third_party/SwiftTerm in
Lithe's source distribution. No upstream terminal parser or PTY code is changed.
